walk-down.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production 2D game-style SPRITE SHEET for the supplied sculptural website character, NOT a scene or a single image.
Input image 1 is the sole identity reference. Preserve this EXACT red-faced observer character: huge textured red sculptural face, long vivid BLUE upper eyelids and dark green lower lids, white dotted cheeks, yellow beads on pink piping, small grey stone mask with white wiry hair on top, orange-brown HUMAN arms and feet, black/white/green zebra hip form, blue gingham rounded thigh, yellow mesh-patterned other thigh. Rich tactile collage/3D sculpture textures matching reference, not a new cartoon. Same proportions and small-scale detail across EVERY frame. Exactly TWO arms and TWO legs throughout.
MANDATORY LAYOUT: exactly EIGHT full-body animation frames, ordered left to right across row 1 then left to right across row 2. A precise regular grid of FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows; each cell is portrait, approximately 2:3 width:height. Overall landscape canvas 4:3 aspect ratio. Same cell framing, same camera, same character scale, same invisible foot baseline around 94% of each cell. Full head, hands and feet inside every cell with transparent padding, never crossing tile boundaries. No characters between cells. Each cell contains ONE version of the character in a DIFFERENT pose of the same continuous animation. Do not repeat an identical pose in all cells.
Background must be TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA across whole sheet and every space between body parts. NO background, floor, shadows, grids, cell borders, dividers, labels, frame numbers, words, typography, props or scenery. Retain antialiased clean cutout edges. Keep eyes open in movement frames.
ANIMATION: eight-phase seamless WALK DOWN / toward viewer cycle, near-frontal view. The character actually WALKS with articulated knees, ankles and shoulders. Arms swing in opposition to legs; head and body bob gently, maintaining identity. Frame 1 left foot forward contact, right foot back; 2 weight lowers onto left foot; 3 right leg passes through with right knee lifted; 4 rise on left support foot with right foot swinging ahead; 5 right foot forward contact, left foot back; 6 weight lowers onto right foot; 7 left knee passes forward; 8 rise on right support foot with left leg preparing next contact. Both arms must visibly swing and the two feet must occupy distinct gait poses. Full-body all eight frames, even where a knee lifts. Ground positions remain aligned, small natural body bob only.
